data_quality_findings: Birth date '1 JAN 1926' is almost certainly a placeholder for year-only knowledge (MyHeritage commonly stores 'abt. 1926' this way). Treat as 'about 1926' until a register entry is found.

Birth place is recorded as Kyjov, but the family is associated with Moravský Písek (son died there). In 1926 most rural births were home births registered in the home parish, so Kyjov may be a confusion with the son/granddaughter's birthplace (Kyjov hospital). Verify which is correct.
Death recorded as year only (2009), no place.
Mother of the subject is unknown – F500049 has no WIFE; genealogy.json P0093.mother is empty.
Marriage P0093 × P0094 (Eundated-marriage-059) has no date or place. Son born 1955 suggests marriage ca. 1950–1955.
Marie Formánková (P0094) has no dates or places at all.
Event Eundated-marriage-066 (P0114 with no bride) is an empty placeholder created from F500049.
All records come from a single secondary source (MyHeritage GEDCOM, S0017); confidence 'possible' everywhere – nothing is backed by a primary record yet.

historical_context.place: Moravský Písek, Hodonín District, South Moravia (Slovácko); ~21 km NE of Hodonín, near Veselí nad Moravou and Uherský Ostroh. First mentioned 1300; Šternberk estate of Veselí 1415–1848; neo-Gothic church of St. Anne built 1909–1910.
life_timeline_estimate: 1939–1945 – teenager during the Protectorate; age 18–19 at the 1945 front passage through the Morava valley
c. 1946–1948 – age for compulsory military service

1948–1950s – communist takeover; collectivization (JZD) of agriculture in South Moravian villages; regional industry: Moravské naftové doly (oil fields around Hodonín), later the Veselí nad Moravou ironworks

archive_links.parish: Moravský Písek became its own Roman Catholic parish in 1784 (deanery Bzenec-Kyjov). Before 1784 it belonged to the parish of Bzenec.
